verdict.rationale: Stripe ships the official Link CLI (@stripe/link-cli, published on npm and confirmed live in a runtime probe, v0.19.2) for agent wallet access, plus the Stripe CLI for sandbox provisioning and mppx CLI for MPP conformance testing, all documented and agent-legible (--llms-full docs). missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on review of the CLI's usability, and multiple overlapping CLIs (stripe, link-cli, mppx) rather than one unified official CLI.
